notes:
## Changes

- Contact sheets and torrents can now be hidden from the menus. They're hidden unless you switch them on in Settings › Library › Sharing folders, which keeps the folder and scene menus shorter.
- Phones and tablets: with "Only show what plays here" on, Performers, Studios and Tags list only the names that have scenes you can play on that device, and their counts include only those scenes.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
